<description>
Introduce a minimal variant of `linux-base-gcc`, and use it for non-GUI builds.

This saves roughly half a megabyte in binary size, in the non-GUI binaries:

| Binary | master (MB) | PR (MB) |
|---|---|---|
| bitcoin | 2.15 | 1.67 |
| bitcoin-cli | 8.20 | 7.72 |
| bitcoin-qt | 43.87 | 43.87 |
| bitcoin-tx | 4.93 | 4.45 |
| bitcoin-util | 4.52 | 4.04 |
| bitcoin-wallet | 9.26 | 8.77 |
| bitcoind | 17.75 | 17.27 |

See https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html:

[quoted text omitted]
</description>

<commits>
e381e29f9a depends: patch around Boost Test std::wcrtomb usage

If libstdc++ is built with --disable-wchar_t, test_bitcoin will fail to
compile.

6cb41040a1 guix: pass --disable-wchar_t to (non-GUI) libstdc++

[quoted text omitted]
See https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html.

6e9ad62323 guix: pass --with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no to (non-GUI) libstdc++

--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=OPTION
[quoted text omitted]

[quoted text omitted]
See: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html

57964dc5bf guix: pass --enable-clocale=generic to (non-GUI) libstdc++

5ec877a74d guix: pass --disable-libstdcxx-filesystem-ts to libstdc++

We don't need libstdc++fs.a, and don't use <experimental/filesystem>.
</commits>

diff --git a/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch b/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..f3fe8c1b3f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+test: don't require std::wcrtomb for wchar_t log formatting
+
+libstdc++ built with --disable-wchar_t drops the std:: overloads
+from <cwchar>. Use the unqualified name so this keeps building against 
+such a toolchain (like in Guix).
+
+--- a/libs/test/include/boost/test/impl/test_tools.ipp
++++ b/libs/test/include/boost/test/impl/test_tools.ipp
+@@ -118,7 +118,7 @@ print_log_value<wchar_t>::operator()( std::ostream& ostr, wchar_t r )
+ {
+     std::mbstate_t state;
+     std::string mb(MB_CUR_MAX, '\0');
+-    std::size_t ret = std::wcrtomb(&mb[0], r, &state);
++    std::size_t ret = wcrtomb(&mb[0], r, &state);
+     if( ret > 0) {
+         ostr << mb;
+     }

</patch>

 "summary": "Introduces a minimal `linux-base-gcc` toolchain variant in Guix for non-GUI static Linux builds, disabling unused `libstdc++` features (`--disable-wchar_t`, `--enable-clocale=generic`, and `--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no`). It also disables the experimental `libstdc++fs` library across Linux GCC builds and adds a patch in `depends` so Boost Test compiles without `std::wcrtomb`.",
 "problem": "Guix non-GUI Linux release binaries link unused `libstdc++` components such as wide-character handling, timezone info, and the experimental filesystem TS library, unnecessarily inflating binary sizes.",
 "card": "Introduces a minimal linux-base-gcc toolchain variant for non-GUI Linux static Guix builds, disabling unused libstdc++ features including wide-character support, zoneinfo, and the filesystem TS library. It also patches Boost Test in depends to invoke wcrtomb without std namespace qualification to maintain compatibility without wchar_t support.
